newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bescorp details Indian power deal.
newsitem.headline: Bescorp details Indian power deal.

text.p: Bescorp Industries Bhd said on Friday that it had signed an agreement with Chalais Holdings Ltd and Khoday India Ltd for a proposed joint venture to build a 300 megawatt thermal power plant in India.
In a statement, Bescorp said the agreement was signed via a joint-venture company Wescopower Generation Ltd.
It said Chalais Holdings has been granted permission by the government of Karnataka State, India to build the plant in Dharwad, India.
The Karnataka government has agreed that Wescopower undertake implementation of the project in place of Chalais, Bescorp said.
Bescorp said it expects to hold 40 percent of Wescopower, with the balance held by Chalais and Khoday.
Its investment in Wescopower will be financed by borrowings, and the amount of investment has not yet been finalised, the statement said.
Bescorp said the proposed venture will allow it to broaden its earnings base. The company's stock has been suspended since January 23, when they closed at 24.20 ringgit.
